title: product
text:
product

clare: Hi team, starting today as Product Designer! Two quick asks: I don’t have Figma org access and I can’t see the Product Research Playbooks in Notion. Who should I ping? Also curious if we have a canonical participant consent template.

oscar: welcome @clare :tada: I handle design ops. I resent the Figma SSO invite at 09:15 — check spam and 'Promotions' tab. If it errors with `SSO: missing_group` let me know. Figma DS link: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/Redwood-DS

design-ops: adding — @clare I just invited you to the "Product Designers" team in Figma and shared the onboarding file. For Notion, looks like your account needs to be in the Product SSO group; IT is processing the group sync now.

clare: Thanks! I see the Figma request but clicking the link shows "Request access" instead of joining.

oscar: that usually means the invite landed but auto-accept didn't run. DM me the exact email and I'll trigger a manual add. Meanwhile, starter tokens are in Drive > Design > StarterAssets (I dropped a zip link in your DM).

research-ops: For consent templates, use consent_standard_v3 in Drive > UX > Templates. We require: purpose, recording permission, data retention period, and opt-out instructions. If you're recruiting external participants, loop Legal for messaging.

clare: Got the Drive zip, thanks. Notion still 403 but this is enough to start. Would love to shadow a research session to learn the note-taking conventions if possible.

design-ops: we have a moderated session tomorrow at 11am — I can add you as an observer. Also we'll do a 20-min design system walkthrough today at 4pm; calendar invite sent.

onboard-bot: :white_check_mark: New hire checklist updated: Figma access (pending manual add), Notion group sync (pending IT), DS walkthrough scheduled (4pm).

clare: Perfect — 4pm works. Appreciate the quick help! I'll post any outstanding access errors here.

oscar: welcome again! If Notion still blocks after EOD ping @it and I'll escalate.
